name: text-edit
title: Text Edit
description: A Tiptap markdown-first rich-text editor in the shared prose typography — a slash menu and a bubble menu instead of a toolbar, a link popover, task lists, tables, code blocks, markdown input rules and paste, and one onCommit path.

meta.whenToUse: Comments, notes, summaries and documents stored as Markdown (format="markdown") or HTML; in-place editing of a MarkdownView with variant="ghost".
meta.whenNotToUse: Plain single-line input (Input) or collaborative real-time docs (deferred text-edit-collab).
